protocol.framing: one UTF-8 JSON object per line

identity.instance: Ephemeral entropy-backed transport-process label, not a KB or durable owner.
identity.incarnation: Independent ephemeral session label, not a grant.
identity.generation: Unsigned 64-bit invocation counter; first admitted envelope is 1, every valid envelope including notifications/refusals consumes one, malformed JSON/envelopes consume none. Exhaustion refuses and closes; no wrap/reuse. Not CitationTableGeneration.
identity.integer_request_ids: Preserve arbitrary-precision signed integer lexical tokens. Fraction/exponent tokens are invalid even when mathematically integral. Parsed integer -0 normalizes to 0. Strings and explicit null remain distinct; missing id is a notification only after envelope admission.
identity.durable_citations: The included writfold-citation/1 descriptor schema names candidate immutable material only; it does not expose a citation RPC method, acquire bytes, authenticate a release, or grant access.

precedence: enforce session state and method-specific schema/capability precedence
prepare complete bounded reply unless notification
write/flush prepared bytes; fatal IO closes the invocation
initialize_order: admit supported capability spellings and current capability set
shutdown_order: flush and close without reading another request
lifecycle.eof: A final non-newline frame is evaluated; EOF then exits 0. Shutdown closes immediately, including shutdown notifications.
lifecycle.oversized: Drain through LF/EOF with bounded memory, report Invalid Request with null id/generation, then continue if input remains.
lifecycle.encoding_failure: Terminate without emitting a partial reply, truncating or substituting the ID; no successful lifecycle change precedes successful complete encoding.
lifecycle.notifications: Well-formed notifications execute lifecycle; method/param/state failures emit nothing. Invalid JSON/envelopes still receive errors.
lifecycle.effects: No corpus, retained-release, grounding, publication, ledger or effect service exists in this profile. No child process is launched.

validation.schema_limit: JSON Schema validates shapes but cannot distinguish integer lexical forms or prove cross-field/order/content/authenticity conditions. Implement the declared byte rules and run the vectors.
citation_conditions: selector first <= last; integer u64 tokens only
Git commit/blob algorithm and full lowercase width match
literal relative UTF-8 path: no empty, dot, parent or NUL components
capture_digest is raw whole-capture SHA256 and becomes semantic ContentId, not native Git blob ID
bind requires exact selected preimage length and raw SHA256; full provenance/access/retention remain external host obligations
validation.stream_safety: No raw malformed values or parser diagnostics are reflected in error details. Correlation IDs are preserved and JSON-escaped, not normalized into another namespace.

blocked_requirements: citation, assessment, finite-collection and frozen read-closure services
